source_evidence: For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
problem: The warehouse department is marked authority="authority", assigning its work to an automated system instead of the named human department.
correction: Change Lane_warehouse laneMeta authority from "authority" to "sovereignty".

source_evidence:
The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could
say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.
problem: Quality inspection is placed between picking and packing even though its order is explicitly unknown, with no annotation declaring that uncertainty.
correction: Remove pick-parts--quality-inspection and quality-inspection--pack-order and their incoming/outgoing references, restore a direct pick-parts to pack-order sequence flow, and leave quality-inspection unconnected with an associated note declaring its unknown order relative to packing and labelling.

problem: The map adds an ERP payment-reminder step after invoicing and supports it with a fabricated source quote about seven days.
correction: Remove send-payment-reminder, its fabricated documentation, lane reference and incident sequence flows; connect generate-and-send-invoice directly to accepted-order-fulfilled and update the incoming/outgoing references.
